extracted.intended_audience: Entities that provide prescription drug coverage to Medicare Part D eligible individuals (e.g., plan sponsors, insurers, employers, third‑party administrators, PBMs)
extracted.subtask_short: Medicare Part D creditable coverage notice
extracted.subtask_description: Providing required disclosure notices to Medicare Part D‑eligible individuals indicating whether their prescription drug coverage is creditable or non‑creditable, using or adapting CMS model notice templates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification requirement: creditable vs non‑creditable
rubrics_metrics.description: Entities that provide prescription drug coverage to Medicare Part D eligible individuals must notify these individuals whether the drug coverage they have is creditable or non‑creditable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a mandatory disclosure obligation for entities providing prescription drug coverage to Medicare Part D eligible individuals. The page supplies model notices intended to be used to meet that obligation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use and modification of CMS Model Disclosure Notices
rubrics_metrics.description: Entities may modify the Model Disclosure Notices provided on this page under 'Downloads' to notify affected individuals whether their drug coverage is creditable or non‑creditable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CMS provides model language but permits entities to adapt the templates as needed to communicate to affected individuals. The guidance implies that adapted versions should still convey whether coverage is creditable or non‑creditable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of model notice templates and language versions
rubrics_metrics.description: Model Creditable Coverage Disclosure Notice (PDF); Model Non‑Creditable Coverage Disclosure Notice (PDF); Spanish versions of both notices are available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Downloads listed on the page include: Model Creditable Coverage Disclosure Notice (PDF), Model Non‑Creditable Coverage Disclosure Notice (PDF), and Spanish equivalents. These templates are the resources recommended for fulfilling the notification requirement.
